# Delta V

> Delta V accelerates adoption of decentralized technologies for businesses and individuals.

## What we do

Delta V is a tech consultancy specialising in decentralized technologies, operating in EU and Swiss markets.

We offer four service lines:

- **Tech Foundations** — web and mobile app development, IT infrastructure, Web3 integration
- **Growth Boost** — strategic expansion support for EU and Swiss markets, public good advocacy and fundraising
- **Cybersecurity** — privacy and security audits, GenAI & agent development, CryptoSec, threat monitoring
- **Research Services** — market research reports, on-chain and OSINT analysis, training

## Why Delta V

We are tech natives — professionals who build, operate, and live the decentralized stack. Every solution we deliver prioritises user self-ownership through decentralized tools.
